test_title: PYST 21: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

 (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) TX – ZV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dad4b32ba82b80f559f7f50bafc67d8d2f2797c89399a926b48d08600247246f.png] 

Option 2) CG – ID

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee5d857c244104ffee50d2a603182ca510a9137ff0dc1a3644ffe4fb9273b1c6.png] 

Option 3) MQ – SN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6182c6cd87b5bc45257c3752c02e11f97f98be20f6f5c201424b054212c696.png] 

Option 4) HL – NI

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f217bb02ad9a1db4270bed768ec8bdfd75ffc17b63f850ccb5d2fbe214e46965.png] 

Thus, out of all 'TX – ZV' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
